description:
"His Highness wishes to take Princess Suri as his consort."

Suri Diar, a princess of the peaceful Rhodion Kingdom, finds her royal castle besieged by the army of Kallane. Amidst the crisis, she receives an unexpected marriage proposal from Valerican Luzara, the King of Kallane, who is notorious for his warmongering. With grim determination, Suri heads to the enemy camp to meet him. 

However, the warmonger Valerican she finally encounters unexpectedly possesses a broad, muscular chest that is exactly her type?!
